newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: U.S. Eximbank eyes Philippine satellite funding.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Eximbank eyes Philippine satellite funding.

text.p: The Export-Import Bank (Eximbank) of the United States said on Tuesday it had signed a letter of interest to lend $225 million for the Philippines' second satellite.

US Eximbank president Martin Kamarck told reporters the bank is studying the possibility of either a direct loan or a loan guarantee for the purchase of a satellite earth station, launch vehicle and insurance for Agila II, which would be launched by a consortium led by the Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co.
The group recently launched the first satellite in time for the APEC summit.

Besides PLDT, other members of the consortium are PT Pasifik Satelit Nusantara, Republic Broadcasting System, Pilipino Telephone Corp, China Everbright group, Philippine Satellite Corp, Cable Entertainment Corp and Philippines Communications Satellite Co Inc.
